decisions.reason: Because it stayed only a briefly mentioned offering while other 2018 launches were either strengthened or already removed, management would likely judge its results as below aspiration and reallocate resources to stronger security lines.

Its move from a general mention in 2018 to a dedicated page in 2019 suggests performance at or above aspiration, and its close fit with the firm's core security competence supports continued retention.
The dedicated 2019 presentation indicates enough traction to justify keeping it, although the hardware element raises costs and uncertainty that make management monitor it more closely.

Even without stronger website prominence, its compliance focus likely complements the firm's established consulting business, so a medium-sized firm with some slack would tend to keep it unless clearer underperformance appears.
